theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)), Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → ‖v‖ = 1 → (∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ μ (closedBall y ρ₀) ≠ ∞) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, (1 - inner ℝ (ν z) v) ∂μ ≤ δ * (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal ∧ ∀ w : Euclid (m + 1), inner ℝ w v = 0 → ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, |inner ℝ (ν z) w| ∂μ ≤ δ * ‖w‖ * (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal
